title: LEGACY V2 Stored Raven Receipt (storage envelope — NOT receipt-v1)
description: LEGACY V2 COMPATIBILITY storage envelope for persisting a POST /verify response. This is not the current receipt-v1 customer contract. New integrations use POST /receipt/v1, preserve the exact receipt-v1 object, and follow /receipt-v1-test-vector.json plus the maintained raven-receipt-verifier. To validate the archived legacy v2 wire receipt published in /receipt-test-vector.json, use /receipt-wire-schema.json. rawResponse is the source of truth and must remain byte-unmodified; derivedExplanation never replaces it; policyDecision must not upgrade the legacy verdict; coverageGaps must remain visible.

request.description: The exact request sent (never includes rpcUrl/issuerIdentity).

coverageGaps.description: Normative. Must never be summarized away.

unsigned.description: Unsigned response annotation; not receipt authority; the signed coverageGaps are the authoritative limitation list. Explicitly NOT part of the signed receipt. Carries notEvaluatedSurfaces (a constant scope disclaimer) and an explanatory note.

notEvaluatedSurfaces.description: Unsigned response annotation; not receipt authority; the signed coverageGaps are the authoritative limitation list. Constant declarative object of surfaces this receipt does NOT evaluate, grouped into offchain (surfaces Raven structurally does NOT evaluate from on-chain data, e.g. team identity, promotion disclosure) and futureLifecycle (on-chain-adjacent surfaces this receipt did not evaluate, e.g. creator-fee history). Separate from coverageGaps; does NOT affect the verdict. A clean on-chain verdict is never evidence about these surfaces.

note.description: Human-readable statement that this annotation is unsigned and not receipt authority.

rawResponse.description: The unmodified verifier response. Source of truth.

policyDecision.description: Caller policy outcome. Must not upgrade the verdict.

derivedExplanation.description: Optional derived text. Never replaces rawResponse.
